workarounds.symptom: G004 fix can change behavior and introduce syntax errors
workarounds.workaround: Fix: [`flake8-logging-format`] Avoid behavior changes and syntax errors in fixes (`G004`). Target files: crates/ruff_linter/src/rules/flake8_logging_format/rules/logging_call.rs, crates/ruff_linter/src/rules/flake8_logging_format/violations.rs, crates/ruff_linter/resources/mdtest/flake8-logging-format/logging-f-string.md. I authored the original fix in #19303. This improves that implementation. (Ref: https://github.com/astral-sh/ruff/pull/27419)

workarounds.symptom: Improve D417 missdetection for *args and **kwargs when backslash.
workarounds.workaround: Fix: [`pydocstyle`] Treat backslash-escaped `*args` and `**kwargs` as documented (`D417`). Target files: crates/ruff_linter/src/rules/pydocstyle/mod.rs, crates/ruff_linter/src/rules/pydocstyle/rules/sections.rs, crates/ruff_linter/resources/test/fixtures/pydocstyle/D417.py. Sphinx-style docstrings often escape the stars as `\*args` and `\*\*kwargs`, because a bare `*` starts emphasis in reST. D417 didn't account for that, so it reported those parameters as undocumented even though they were documented. (Ref: https://github.com/astral-sh/ruff/pull/29536)

workarounds.symptom: PLE0643 (potential-index-error) counts a starred element of a list or tuple literal as one item
workarounds.workaround: Fix: [`pylint`] Avoid false positive on starred elements (`PLE0643`). Target files: crates/ruff_linter/src/rules/pylint/rules/potential_index_error.rs, crates/ruff_linter/resources/test/fixtures/pylint/potential_index_error.py. `potential-index-error` (`PLE0643`) statically calculates the length of sequence literals (lists and tuples) using the count of AST elements (`elts.len()`). When a sequence contains starred expressions (e.g., `(*a, 9)[2]` or `[*a, *a][2]`), the starred element is counted as a single item, causing `PLE0643`... (Ref: https://github.com/astral-sh/ruff/pull/29483)
